perfil: Whether the steel claws she'd scavenged or the left hand imbued with special magic, Cosette uses her weapons to break the chains of fate.

habilidades.b: Lashes out with both claws, dealing multiple instances of damage.

tpl.s: Lashes out with both claws. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG.

habilidades.b: Attacks with hook punches that deal multiple instances of DMG and inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. When the Main Skill deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.

tpl.s: Attacks with double hook punches, each dealing ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Umbra Skill DMG. Inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. When Nocturn Hooks (Main Skill) deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦2⟧ for 6s.

habilidades.b: Deals multiple instances of AoE DMG and inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. When the Support Skill deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.

tpl.s: Strikes quickly with the steel claws, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG, and inflicting ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. When the Support Skill Abyssal Hunter deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 6s.

habilidades.b: Pulls enemies in constantly, dealing AoE DMG and inflicting ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩.

tpl.s: Channels energy and keeps pulling nearby enemies close, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Ultimate DMG and inflicting ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩.

builds.d: A build that allows support Trekkers' attacks to increase the activation frequency of Main Skills.
A single-target combat build that allows skills to enhance Auto Attacks and inflicts marks.

l.b: Increases the Main Skill's DMG and Attack Range. When casting the Main Skill, increases all friendly units' Crit Rate.
l.s: Increases DMG of the second heavy punch of Nocturn Hooks (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧, as well as its Attack Range. When casting the Main Skill, increases all friendly units' Crit Rate by ⟦1⟧ for 8s.

l.b: When any other friendly unit lands a Crit Hit, reduces the Main Skill's Cooldown, leaves claw marks and inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩.
l.s: When any other friendly unit lands a Crit Hit, reduces the Cooldown of Nocturn Hooks (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧s, and leaves claw marks at the target's location, dealing ⟦1⟧ of Cosette's ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. This effect can only be triggered 5 times per Skill cast.

l.b: When the Main Skill deals DMG, increases targets' Umbra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Nocturn Hooks (Main Skill) deals DMG, increases the targets' Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: When the Main Skill kills a target, increases all friendly units' ATK.
l.s: When Nocturn Hooks (Main Skill) kills a target, increases all friendly units' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, increases all friendly units' ATK.
l.s: When casting Nocturn Hooks (Main Skill), increases all friendly units' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: After casting the Main Skill, enhances Auto Attacks for a period of time.
l.s: After casting Nocturn Hooks (Main Skill), Cosette's Auto Attack is enhanced for ⟦0⟧s, increasing its Attack Range, Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧, and ATK SPD by ⟦2⟧. Her Auto Attack can also inflict ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩.

l.b: When Cosette inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ multiple times on the target, leaves claw marks and increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Cosette inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ on the same target for the 3rd time, leaves claw marks, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Umbra Skill DMG, increasing the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 3s, and inflicting ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩. This effect can only be triggered once per second.

l.b: When Cosette uses Auto Attacks, increases all friendly units' ATK.
l.s: When Cosette uses Auto Attacks, increases all friendly units' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: For every target near Cosette inflicted with ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases her DEF.
l.s: For each target near Cosette inflicted with ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases her DEF by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: After Cosette deals multiple instances of Auto Attack DMG, she gains a shield.
l.s: After Cosette deals 5 instances of Auto Attack DMG, she gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of her Base Max HP for 5s. This effect can only be triggered once every 6s.

l.b: When an ally triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases their ATK.
l.s: When a squadmate triggers ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases their ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Cosette can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases the ATK of a random support Trekker.
l.s: Cosette can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases the ATK of a random support Trekker by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: Cosette can dodge through barriers. When dodging, increases her ATK SPD.
l.s: Cosette can dodge through barriers. When dodging, increases her ATK SPD by ⟦0⟧ for 3s.

l.b: Increases Ultimate DMG to targets at the center.
l.s: Increases Dark Apocalypse (Ultimate)'s Ultimate DMG to targets at the center by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Dark Apocalypse (Ultimate) deals damage, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, reduces the targets' ATK.
l.s: When Dark Apocalypse (Ultimate) deals DMG, reduces the targets' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s.

builds.d: A build that enhances claw strike range and pulls targets, synergizing with the main Trekker's attacks.
A build that increases the number of claw strikes and boosts the squad's DPS.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Attack Range, and increases the Umbra DMG Taken of targets caught within the claw marks' range.
l.s: Increases the Attack Range of Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill).  Increases the Umbra DMG Taken of targets caught within the claw marks' range by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The Support Skill can pull targets. Increases the Umbra DMG Taken of targets caught within the claw marks' range.
l.s: Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) can pull in targets.  Increases the Umbra DMG Taken of targets caught within the claw marks' range by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The Support Skill attacks random nearby targets. When Cosette inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩, increases all friendly units' ATK.
l.s: Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) now attacks random nearby targets. When Cosette inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ to a target without a Mark, increases all friendly units' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, increases targets' Umbra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: Each claw strike from the Support Skill increases the main Trekker's DEF.
l.s: Each claw strike from Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) increases the main Trekker's DEF by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, up to 8 stacks.

l.b: The Support Skill will launch more strikes. The claw strikes can increase all friendly units' ATK.
l.s: Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) will launch ⟦0⟧ additional claw strikes. For every ⟦1⟧ claw strikes, increases all friendly units' ATK by ⟦2⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Adds a finishing heavy strike to the Support Skill. Cosette's claw strikes can increase all friendly units' ATK.
l.s: Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) will also launch a finishing heavy strike, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Umbra Skill DMG. For every ⟦1⟧ claw strikes, increases all friendly units' ATK by ⟦2⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 4 times.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, there is a chance to stun the target. Also increases all friendly units' ATK.
l.s: When Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) deals DMG, there is a 30% chance to stun the target for 3s. Also increases all friendly units' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s. This effect can only be triggered once every 0.5s.

l.b: When Cosette repeatedly inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ on the same target, increases Umbra squadmates' ATK.
l.s: When Cosette repeatedly inflicts ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ on the same target, increases Umbra squadmates' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, there is a chance to reduce the target's Resilience.
l.s: When Abyssal Hunter (Support Skill) deals DMG, there is a 30% chance to reduce the target's Resilience by ⟦0⟧. This effect can only be triggered once every 0.5s.

l.b: Increases Umbra Trekkers' ATK.
l.s: Increases Umbra Trekkers' ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Cosette is on the battlefield, increases the main Trekker's ATK.
l.s: When Cosette is on the battlefield, increases the main Trekker's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While Cosette is casting the Support Skill, increases the main Trekker's DEF.
l.s: While Cosette is casting the Support Skill, increases the main Trekker's DEF by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Ultimate DMG to targets at the center.
l.s: Increases Dark Apocalypse (Ultimate)'s Ultimate DMG to targets at the center by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Dark Apocalypse (Ultimate) deals damage, increases the target's Umbra DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, reduces the targets' ATK.
l.s: When Dark Apocalypse (Ultimate) deals DMG, reduces the targets' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s.
